notes:
- Account overview: Avalon Command Solutions is a mid-to-large defense integrator supporting naval intelligence and civil defense command centers. Heavy bureaucratic procurement; prime/subcontractor model.
- Primary ask: on-prem, air-gapped RAG search across classified repositories. Focus on embeddings + reranking to improve precision for analyst workflows.
- Scale estimate: initial index 25M documents (OCR PDFs, intel reports, comms), growth to 50–60M vectors. Want vector store + reranker with deterministic audit trail.
- Perf targets: 95th percentile latency <300ms for short queries with rerank of top-100 candidates; sustained burst throughput ~60 qps during exercises. Cost per query considered in capex/opex tradeoffs; willing to invest in hardware to avoid cloud egress costs.
- Model preferences/constraints: Open models preferred for provenance; quantized weights OK if FIPS/HSM-signed and reproducible. Need clear guidance on quantization accuracy regressions. Reranker expected to be a smaller fine-tuned model, embeddings from a vetted encoder.
- Security & compliance: mandatory air-gapped deployment (no outbound egress), HSM-backed key management, persistent audit logs (7+ years), SSO via agency IdP (SAML), strict software bill-of-materials & artifact signing. Evidence of SOC2/ISO27001 and FIPS support required for procurement packet.
- POC plan (agreed draft): 6-week air-gapped POC. Week 1: infra prep (network, HSM, firewall rules). Week 2–3: ingest 1M doc subset, run embedding pipeline, build index. Week 4: plug in reranker, run evaluation harness. Week 5: latency and batching/caching tuning (Redwood Optimize suggestions). Week 6: security scans, artifact signing, signoff.
